audience: EBS software engineers preparing Bioflow input files

overall.verdict: 1 of 3 use cases are ready. The rest list what to fix under 'use_cases'.

use_cases.what_it_checks: Combine trials across environments to estimate genetic values (needs phenotypes and a Single Trial Analysis).
use_cases.summary: This file cannot run MTA (Multi Trial Analysis) yet: 10 requirement(s) not met. See 'how_to_fix' below.
blocking_issues: SOA (Single Trial Analysis) has been run
predictions exist for the STA analysisId
predictions carry the columns MTA reads
modeling has designationEffectType for the STA id
metrics carry an H2/r2 parameter for the STA id
metadata$pheno maps environment, designation and trait
at least 2 environments with >1 prediction row

checks.requirement: phenotypic data is present
checks.what_it_means: No phenotypic data was supplied, so there is nothing for MTA to analyze.
checks.how_to_fix: Provide a phenotype file; MTA is a phenotype analysis and cannot run without one.
checks.technical_detail: MTA is a phenotype analysis; with no phenotype data there is nothing to analyze

checks.requirement: SOA (Single Trial Analysis) has been run
checks.what_it_means: Single Trial Analysis (SOA) has not run on this object, so trial-combining (MTA) cannot start.
checks.how_to_fix: Provide phenotypic data so the script runs model-based QA and SOA automatically. If phenotypes are present but SOA still did not run, check the earlier log for the resMod/staLMM warning.
checks.technical_detail: mod_mtaLMMsolveApp.R blocks the run when there is no 'soa' (STA) stamp in status

checks.requirement: status$analysisId is numeric
checks.what_it_means: The analysis identifier is not a number, which the analysis stamp menu cannot read.
checks.how_to_fix: Re-generate the object with this script (it creates numeric analysis IDs); do not hand-edit the IDs.
checks.technical_detail: the STA dropdown calls as.POSIXct(analysisId); a character id yields NA labels

checks.requirement: no duplicate 'sta' status rows
checks.what_it_means: There is more than one Single Trial Analysis entry, which confuses the analysis menu.
checks.technical_detail: names(traitsMta) <- paste(analysisIdName, ...) errors on length mismatch

checks.requirement: predictions exist for the STA analysisId
checks.what_it_means: No trial results were produced, usually because phenotypes or traits were missing or too sparse.
checks.how_to_fix: Check that the phenotype file has the chosen traits with enough data, and run with runSOA = TRUE.
checks.technical_detail: metLMMsolver stops with 'Not enough data ... perform an STA' when < 2 rows

checks.requirement: predictions carry the columns MTA reads
checks.what_it_means: The results table is missing columns the trial-combining analysis needs.
checks.how_to_fix: Re-generate with this script unmodified; if it persists, the phenotype file may be missing required fields.
checks.technical_detail: missing: analysisId, trait, environment, designation, predictedValue, stdError, reliability, entryType

checks.requirement: predictions has no non-canonical extra column
checks.what_it_means: The results table has an unexpected extra column that breaks trial-combining.

checks.requirement: modeling has designationEffectType for the STA id
checks.what_it_means: The Single Trial Analysis did not record how genotype effects were modelled.
checks.how_to_fix: Re-run with runSOA = TRUE so Single Trial Analysis records this automatically.
checks.technical_detail: metLMMsolver evaluates if(... == 'BLUP'); absence gives 'missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed'

checks.requirement: metrics carry an H2/r2 parameter for the STA id
checks.what_it_means: No heritability/reliability metric was produced by Single Trial Analysis.
checks.how_to_fix: Re-run with runSOA = TRUE and ensure traits have enough replicated data.
checks.technical_detail: metLMMsolver keeps only environments whose heritability falls in [heritLB, heritUB]

checks.requirement: metadata$pheno maps environment, designation and trait
checks.what_it_means: The phenotype column mapping is incomplete (environment, designation and trait must all be mapped).
checks.how_to_fix: Check the phenotype file has the expected EBS columns so the script can map environment, germplasmName and the traits.
checks.technical_detail: missing: environment, designation, trait - the MTA input panels stay hidden

checks.requirement: data$pheno has a literal 'environment' column
checks.what_it_means: The phenotype data has no 'environment' column for grouping trials.
checks.how_to_fix: Provide the EBS phenotype fields the script builds 'environment' from (stage, year, season, site, experiment, occurrence).
checks.technical_detail: cgiarPipeline::summaryWeather() aggregates on it when data$weather is absent

checks.requirement: at least 2 environments with >1 prediction row
checks.what_it_means: Trial-combining needs results from at least two environments; fewer were found.
checks.how_to_fix: Provide phenotype data spanning at least two environments (occurrences).
checks.technical_detail: found 0; mod_mtaLMMsolveApp.R zeroes any env x trait cell <= 1

execution_checks.detail: No SOA (soa) stamp present; MOA has no single-trial results to combine.

use_cases.what_it_checks: Check that each F1 hybrid is really the cross of its recorded mother and father, using marker data.
use_cases.summary: This file can run F1 qa/qc (gVerif).

checks.requirement: data$geno is a genlight object
checks.what_it_means: The genotype data was not loaded into the expected marker format.
checks.technical_detail: individualVerification only builds Markers when class(geno)[1] == 'genlight'

checks.requirement: status contains a 'qaGeno' row
checks.what_it_means: The genotype QA step is missing, so marker-based modules cannot start.
checks.technical_detail: the QA-geno stamp dropdown is built from status[module == 'qaGeno']

checks.requirement: data$geno_imp is keyed by the qaGeno analysisId
checks.what_it_means: The imputed marker data is not linked to the genotype QA step.

checks.requirement: metadata$geno has a 'ploidity' row
checks.what_it_means: The genotype ploidy was not recorded.
checks.technical_detail: mod_hybridityApp.R reads ploidy from metadata$geno[parameter == 'ploidity'] (note the spelling)

checks.requirement: data$pedigree is present
checks.what_it_means: No pedigree information was supplied.
checks.technical_detail: mod_hybridityApp.R shows 'Pedigree information is required to run this module'

checks.requirement: pedigree has a crossType column
checks.what_it_means: The pedigree does not say which individuals are F1 hybrids.
checks.technical_detail: individualVerification stops without it

checks.requirement: crossType contains the literal 'F1'
checks.what_it_means: No rows are marked as F1 hybrids, so there is nothing to verify as a hybrid.
checks.technical_detail: the comparison is == "F1", case-sensitive

checks.requirement: crossType has no missing values
checks.what_it_means: Some rows have a blank crossType, which corrupts the hybrid selection.
checks.technical_detail: ped[ped$crossType == 'F1', ] uses == so NA rows become all-NA phantom rows

checks.requirement: F1 progeny (sample_id) found in the marker matrix
checks.what_it_means: The genotyped F1 hybrids could not be matched to the pedigree.
checks.technical_detail: 8 of 8 matched; individualVerification stops with 'None of your progeny genotypes have marker information'

checks.requirement: F1 mothers found in the marker matrix
checks.what_it_means: The mothers of the F1 hybrids are not genotyped, so the cross cannot be verified.
checks.technical_detail: 2 matched; parents must be genotyped too

checks.requirement: F1 fathers found in the marker matrix
checks.what_it_means: The fathers of the F1 hybrids are not genotyped, so the cross cannot be verified.
checks.technical_detail: 4 matched; parents must be genotyped too

checks.requirement: at least 8 markers
checks.what_it_means: There are too few markers for a reliable verification (at least 8 are needed).
checks.technical_detail: found 10; crossVerification returns NA probMatch below min_markers = 8

execution_checks.note: individualVerification ran; probMatch computed for 8 F1(s).

use_cases.what_it_checks: Check recorded parentage of later-generation lines against marker data (designation/mother/father triplets).
use_cases.summary: This file cannot run Pedigree qa/qc (qaPed) yet: 2 requirement(s) not met. See 'how_to_fix' below.
blocking_issues: at least one fully genotyped designation/mother/father triplet
at least 2 fully genotyped triplets for clustering

checks.requirement: data$geno is present
checks.what_it_means: No genotype data was supplied for pedigree verification.
checks.technical_detail: qaPed needs the raw genlight for loc.all and the marker matrix

checks.requirement: data$geno has allele strings in loc.all
checks.what_it_means: The marker allele information needed for pedigree checks is missing.
checks.technical_detail: plot_impossible() splits glgeno$loc.all on '/' to build IUPAC triplets

checks.requirement: status contains a 'qaGeno' row
checks.what_it_means: The genotype QA step is missing, so marker-based modules cannot start.
checks.technical_detail: req(input$version2qaPed) blocks the module until a qaGeno stamp exists

checks.requirement: data$geno_imp is keyed by the qaGeno analysisId
checks.what_it_means: The imputed marker data is not linked to the genotype QA step.
checks.technical_detail: qaPed resolves geno_imp by which(names(geno_imp) == version2qaPed)

checks.requirement: metadata$pedigree maps 'father' to a non-empty column
checks.what_it_means: The pedigree does not map a father (male parent) column.
checks.technical_detail: is_valid_fatherCol() gates the module's green 'data is complete' message

checks.requirement: pedigree resolves designation, mother and father
checks.what_it_means: The pedigree is missing one of the required columns: designation, mother or father.

checks.requirement: metadata$pedigree aligns positionally with data$pedigree
checks.what_it_means: The pedigree columns and their descriptions are out of step (an internal consistency problem).

checks.requirement: at least one fully genotyped designation/mother/father triplet
checks.what_it_means: No line has its designation, mother AND father all genotyped, so no triplet can be checked.
checks.how_to_fix: Genotype the lines together with both their parents, and make sure all three names match the VCF (as designations).
checks.technical_detail: 0 of 14 row(s) have all three individuals in the marker matrix; without any, every metric is 'NO GENO DATA' and mclust::Mclust() errors

checks.requirement: at least 2 fully genotyped triplets for clustering
checks.what_it_means: Fewer than two complete (line + both parents genotyped) triplets exist; the statistics need at least two.
checks.how_to_fix: Provide at least two lines that have both parents genotyped, with names matching the VCF (as designations).
checks.technical_detail: found 0; plot_GRM() calls mclust::Mclust(GLM_metric, G = 2), which errors with < 2 points

checks.requirement: triplet-completeness gate for the comparison is met
checks.what_it_means: Too few pedigree rows list a designation, mother and father together for the comparison to run.
checks.technical_detail: 8 of 14 row(s) have designation, mother and father all present; plot_impossible() takes the 'Not enough matching information' branch otherwise

execution_checks.detail: no fully genotyped designation/mother/father triplet (every triplet would be 'NO GENO DATA').
